_comment: ENCOUNTER RARITY SYSTEM: common (60% chance), uncommon (25% chance), rare (10% chance), very_rare (3% chance), ultra_rare (1.5% chance), legendary (0.4% chance), mythical (0.1% chance). Early areas should have minimal legendary/mythical encounters. Powerful Pokemon are intentionally rare to maintain game balance while allowing for anime-style storytelling surprises.

name: celadon-city
description: A large city with a department store and casino. Erika leads the Grass-type Gym here.

story_events.description: Team Rocket has taken over the Game Corner's basement
Annual ceremony celebrating Eevee's evolution possibilities
Special discount day at Celadon Department Store

lore.history: Built around ancient grove sacred to Grass Pokemon, became major commercial hub
legends: The original Celebi still protects the city's gardens
Ancient tree spirits grant power to Grass-type Pokemon
mysteries: Strange perfume from the gym affects Pokemon behavior
Underground tunnels connect to Team Rocket's secret base
lore.cultural_significance: Center of Pokemon fashion and beauty, home to legendary department store

name: cerulean-city
description: A coastal city with a beautiful bridge. Misty leads the Water-type Gym here.

story_events.description: Team Rocket breaks into Bill's house to steal rare Pokemon data
A wild Lapras appears in the city waters during heavy fog
Annual Pokemon tournament on Nugget Bridge

lore.history: Founded as a trading port 400 years ago, became famous for water Pokemon research
legends: The original Lapras that founded the city still swims in the deeper waters
Mew was once spotted playing with wild Psyduck near the bridge
mysteries: Strange blue lights seen over the water during full moons
Ancient underwater ruins visible during low tide
lore.cultural_significance: Home to the first Pokemon Water Show, birthplace of modern Pokemon battling techniques

name: viridian-forest
description: A mysterious forest filled with Bug-type Pokemon and ancient secrets.

story_events.description: The ancient shrine glows and Celebi may appear to worthy trainers
Team Rocket attempts to clear the forest for their base
Large groups of Pikachu migrate through the forest

lore.history: Ancient forest protected by Celebi for over 1000 years, first Pokemon preserve
legends: Celebi planted the first seeds of this forest
The shrine was built by ancient people who worshipped forest spirits
mysteries: Time distortions occur near the shrine
Strange Pokemon cries heard deep in the forest
Trees that grow in perfect spirals
lore.cultural_significance: Sacred forest, training ground for new Pokemon trainers

name: power-plant
description: An abandoned power facility where Electric-type Pokemon have made their home.

story_events.description: Zapdos awakens during a massive electrical storm at the plant
Scientists accidentally create digital Pokemon during system maintenance
Team Rocket tries to steal the plant's remaining energy

lore.history: Built 50 years ago to power all of Kanto, abandoned after mysterious electrical incidents
legends: Zapdos was trapped here during construction
The plant's energy attracted Electric Pokemon from across the region
mysteries: Strange electromagnetic readings in the basement
Digital Pokemon appearing in the computer systems
lore.cultural_significance: Symbol of human technology meeting Pokemon power

name: pokemon-tower
description: A solemn tower where deceased Pokemon are laid to rest, filled with spiritual energy.

notable_npcs.name: Channeler Patricia
notable_npcs.personality: caring, helps lost souls find peace

story_events.description: The spirit of Cubone's mother appears to protect the tower
Mew appears to honor fallen Pokemon during the full moon
Team Rocket disturbs the tower's peace to capture Ghost Pokemon

lore.history: Built 200 years ago as a memorial to all Pokemon, became a spiritual nexus
legends: The tower was built on ancient burial grounds
Pokemon spirits find peace here before moving on
Mew visits to bless the departed
mysteries: Strange voices heard in empty rooms
The eternal flame that never goes out
lore.cultural_significance: Sacred memorial site, place of healing and remembrance
